name: Orihara Akane
source:
A tall and slender 20-year-old.
She claims to be the girl named "A-chan" who appears in the ghost story "The House with the Red Roof".
She is kind and thoughtful, yet strong-willed and able to take the initiative.
She is searching for "S-san", the storyteller of "The House with the Red Roof".

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
